object_description: two buildings framing a controlled route-end square
design_condition: The two buildings are positioned to frame a controlled space at the end of the route from the town, but the intended completeness is weakened when only the first stage is built.

positive.statement: The controlled space between the two buildings is considered very interesting in its completeness.
The position of the first-stage building, especially the multi-purpose hall, is appreciated for its close relation to the kindergarten.
The architectural quality is considered satisfactory after refinement during development.
The proposed spaces are interesting and high-quality, with good functional and circulation organization.

negative.statement: The intended route-end space lacks completeness when only the first stage is realized.
The plinth creates a large space without a clear function, while the two flowerbeds deny the square's potential.
The layout of the football pitches and remaining green area is not sufficiently thorough.
No adequate construction solutions are presented to rationalize costs as requested in the competition brief.
